title: Runbooks plugin transport
description: JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON object per line. Requests on standard input; responses and notifications on standard output; logs on standard error. Every request has an id; no batches. Only the plugin sends notifications, and each names its request in params.request. `configure` is the first call. Closing standard input stops the plugin. A call still in flight when standard input closes may get no answer; the app reads none after it closes standard input. Unknown fields are ignored, except a field that narrows what a call may do, which needs a new protocol version.

id.description: A request id. The caller chooses it; the plugin echoes it.
null when the plugin could not read the request's id: a line that is not JSON, or not a request.

notification.description: Sent only by the plugin, never with an id. The generator cannot express `not`, so the transport owner rejects a message with both an id and a method where it classifies lines.

code.description: -32000 for every kind below except invalidParams (-32602). A request the plugin cannot read gets its JSON-RPC code with kind invalidParams: -32700 for a line that is not JSON, -32600 for one that is not a request, -32601 for an unknown method.

message.description: For a person. Never parsed, and never carries a secret.

baseErrorKind.description: The error kinds every plugin may return, whatever its kind.

caller.description: The calling app and its version: runbooks/0.31.0.

callTimeoutsMillis.description: How long the app waits for each method's answer, in milliseconds, keyed by method name, configure's own included. A plugin answers a call it cannot finish in time with error kind timedOut at least 1000 ms before its method's limit. The app's own timer, at the limit, ends the session.

driverVersion.description: The plugin's own version. RFC-188's name, kept for every kind.

cloud.description: RFC-188's field: the cloud a driver serves. A credential plugin may leave it out.
